Base.Name: Dark blazer
Base.Description: Professional dark blazer over tech-casual attire, sleeves pushed up

Sources: Bright green CoCo raster glow from a color composite CRT as the dominant light
Cyan and magenta neon rim light from the room

Situation.Name: Twenty epochs, then the assembly
Situation.Setting: The same night-time retro-computing workbench as posts one and two. A worn silver 1981 Radio Shack Color Computer with black keyboard and a beige composite CRT showing a green raster. No modern computer performs the demonstration.
Situation.Camera: Wide landscape editorial banner. Three-quarter view across the workbench. Character on the left, CoCo and CRT on the right, two clearly separated fanfold printouts in the foreground. Keep the important subjects within a central crop that works at 16:9.

CharacterPose.Expression: Focused, deliberate inspection; no surprise or revelation
CharacterPose.BodyPosition: Seated at the workbench, leaning forward slightly
CharacterPose.Gesture: One hand rests at a marked stopping point on the training checkpoint printout; the other rests beside the assembly listing. Natural hands, no floating gestures.

Article.Name: Training checkpoint printout
Article.Description: Green-bar fanfold paper with a small sequence of checkpoint rows. One amber marker indicates epoch 20. It is a physical record being inspected, not a magical diagram. No invented computer names, numerical results or fabricated charts.
Article.Application: Foreground focal object beneath her hand

Article.Name: 6809 assembly listing
Article.Description: A second narrower fanfold sheet, with monospaced instruction-like lines. Text can be too small to read. Do not fabricate legible code.
Article.Application: Beside the checkpoint sheet, visibly separate and secondary

Article.Name: 1981 CoCo and composite CRT
Article.Description: Use the project hardware references for the silver case, black keys and beige CRT. Bright green display with dark uppercase pixel blocks, no lowercase, no modern terminal UI.
Article.Application: Right half of frame; screen subordinate to the physical inspection

Environment.Name: Workbench
Environment.Description: Worn wooden surface, restrained cables, cyan and magenta room lighting

KeyDetails: The woman deliberately chooses a stopping point; she does not discover her own design by accident.
Training progression is the primary subject; processor implementation is secondary.
No robot, brain, mind, humanoid machine, floating neural network or anthropomorphic computer.
No title text, slogans, invented outputs, fake measured values, illegible text pretending to be evidence.
This is an illustration, not a photograph or a hardware timing claim.
Situation.LightingFocus: Green CRT light on hands and paper; restrained amber at the selected checkpoint; cyan and magenta rim light consistent with the previous banners.

ArticleContext.Title: Twenty epochs, then the assembly
Themes: Loss continues falling while useful novel names decline
A person chooses the stopping point using a task-specific measurement
The same update can be followed through integer processor instructions

NegativeConstraints: no text outside the authentic CRT output and the non-legible printout
